Differentiating the selected antiderivatives in q-12921 and q-114950 gives e^{3x}\\sin(5x) and e^{-3x}\\cos x respectively. q-84842 has (y+1)^2=-2(x+3), with the shown vertex and point; the selected parameterization generates the entire parabola. q-84859 eliminates t to give (y-1)^2=-5(x+1). q-89774 has y^2-x^2=1, generated by x=tan t, y=sec t where defined; both branches require allowing both signs of sec t. q-106685 restricts t to (-π/2,π/2), making sec t positive and tracing exactly the upper branch. q-14616 sums signed areas -π+6+π-1/2=11/2. q-86170 sums a negative rectangle and positive trapezoid, -5+10=5; the isolated value at x=1 does not affect the integral. q-36039 is injective on I and II because their component ranges are disjoint, but III has overlapping ranges (2,3). q-66729 is strictly monotone on each of I and II, while III contains repeated values on opposite sides of x=1. Its source answer's double space is equivalent to the current choice's single space. q-127520 differentiates y^2=-2x to obtain -1/y, valid where y≠0. q-127525 differentiates x^2/4+(y-1)^2/9=1 to obtain -9x/[4(y-1)], valid where y≠1.
